books.special_desc: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition, Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.
books.share_text: I was married to the magic genie, but I lost him.

books.book_title: The School for Bad Boys: Bully in the Closet
books.special_desc: In an all boy's reform school where homosexual acts mean immediate expulsion, will enemies to lovers Easton and Xander risk it all when they realize their true feelings for each other?
books.share_text: My forbidden gay love is my reform school bully.

books.special_desc: Based on the Wattpad novel by Emily Jean. Determined to lose her virginity before she starts college, Farrah Blake strikes a deal with her best friend and crush since forever, the billionaire heir Ethan Sinclair, who will find the perfect guy for her first time, or take her v-card himself.
books.share_text: My best friend promised to take my virginity?!

books.special_desc: After being sent to Maplewood Reform School—a last stop before prison for the problem sons of wealthy families—openly gay teen Cody Calloway is NOT welcome. After all, the first rule of Maplewood is clear: any homosexual activity earns an immediate expulsion. Enter Beckett Hayes, the school's straight golden boy with a girlfriend, a dark past, and a growing obsession with Cody. Every stolen touch puts their freedom on the line…but some things are worth the risk.
books.share_text: Would you risk prison for the person you love?

books.special_desc: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. After a devastating senior year of high school, Kennedy made two rules for herself. 1. No one will know she's related to her brother and 2. She will never fall for another one of her brother's rivals. When Shay Coleman barges into her life with his irritating and irresistable charm, she's treatened to break both of them...
books.share_text: He marked me as his target on day one. I swore I'd never fall for a monster. So why do I keep running toward him?

books.book_title: One Good Deed, One Great Fortune
books.special_desc: Fifteen years ago, kindhearted lumber magnate Thomas helped a penniless young Harriet get her start, sealing their partnership with a brass plumb bob. Years later, Thomas is betrayed by his scheming wife Grace, her lover Victor, and his three stepchildren. With Bennett Timber gutted, his workers demanding their wages, and his mother gravely ill, Thomas is pushed to the brink. Just when all hope seems lost, Harriet returns as a powerful oil tycoon—determined to restore her business partner’s dignity and reclaim everything stolen from him.
books.share_text: One Good Deed Saved His Fallen Empire

books.special_desc: Luke Peterson is a seventeen-year-old outcast surviving a violent home and relentless school bullying in Chicago's South Side. When a mysterious representative of the Peterson Group — a global financial empire — reveals Luke is the founder's only legitimate heir, Luke receives the family's ancient signet ring, unlocking five abilities: invisibility, magnetic force, time suspension, X-ray vision, and spirit summoning. What follows is a methodical, deeply satisfying reversal. Every humiliation Luke has endured becomes the setup for a public reckoning — engineered with precision, executed with style.
books.share_text: A bullied Chicago slum kid discovers he's the secret heir to a global empire — and the ancient ring that comes with it gives him five superpowers to settle every score.

books.book_title: The Adopted Daughter Came Back Powerful
books.special_desc: Mute rancher Martha and Frank take in abused orphan Lily and raise her to Frontier Edge's Chief Architect. Their son Ethan frames the couple to steal the ranch's $2.8M and throws them out beaten. At his birthday gala Lily reveals her title and brings the heir to his knees. In a warehouse Frank takes a bullet for the son who betrayed him—chosen love outweighs blood.
books.share_text: Blood betrayed them. Chosen love saved them.

books.special_desc:
Based on the novel by Abbi Glines.
Sadie White takes her mom’s housekeeping job at the Stone family beachside mansion and accidentally saves global pop star Jax Stone from a mob of fans. Their worlds collide through forbidden chemistry, steamy tension, and explosive jealousy as Sadie is swept into Jax’s glamorous — and dangerous — life. But fame, sabotage, viral scandals, and heartbreak threaten to tear them apart. As Sadie discovers who she is outside of the chaos, she and Jax must decide whether love can survive the glare of the spotlight.
books.share_text: He has everything, but can't breathe without me.

books.book_title: If Loving You is a Sin, then I'll Go to Hell
books.special_desc: Ellie Jones has been a good girl her whole life, that is until she loses her virginity to bad boy Asher King at her first high school party. The two fall for each other and she gets pregnant. However Ellie's father, the Pastor, and Asher's family, The Red Snakes Gang, wants to keep them apart and take away their baby. Now he has vowed to protect her, no matter the cost.
books.share_text: A good girl gets pregnant with a bad boy's baby!

books.special_desc: All her life, farm girl Lenore Williams has been bullied by spoiled heiress Ada Thornton. When Ada steals Lenore's fiance and kills her father, Lenore swears revenge - by seducing Ada's hot bachelor father, the mysterious mogul of Thornton Estates. It's all for revenge, so why does he make her feel things she's never felt before?
books.share_text: Sorry, bully. Your Daddy is now my stallion.

books.special_desc: When Reese unexpectedly reunites with her ex-best friend and first love Grayson four years after he broke her heart, she agrees to pose as his fake girlfriend for his sister's wedding. But as old feelings threaten to bubble out, Reese must decide if a chance at true love is worth the risk of repeating history.
books.share_text: Always the bestie, never the bride.
